description: Component-scoped overrides. Every value here is read from the real component file named in `source`.

scrolled.note: the header's scrolled state SWAPS variant outright; this is not a hover state

heroSolid.note: carries NO border, which is why it measures 36px tall rather than the usual 38px — the border is load-bearing on height

top-white.note: CMS pageOptions headerTheme:white — /platform + the 6 industry routes

squareBracket.description: The site's signature primitive, ~40 call sites. A 1px horizontal hairline with a 1px vertical end-tick at each end, drawn in currentColor.

numberFlow.lineHeightTrap: The `stat-56`/`stat-48` roles declare line-height 1 even though the shipped CSS says 1.1. The roles are only ever applied to the <number-flow-react> custom element, whose shadow-root styles force line-height:1 on the host, so 1.1 never takes effect. Measured live: 56/56 @1440, 45.76/45.76 @768, 40/40 @390. Do NOT 'restore' 1.1 — CLONE_SPEC §4.5's stats-section heights encode the 1.1 error.
